cachePolicy: No OS cache eviction; same generation session across each case's warmups and measurements, new session for the next case
hostConditions: Quiet-window availability must be arranged by the operator; this command does not establish system idleness or control other workloads

memoryScope: Per-iteration maximum observed physical footprint, resident bytes and default Metal device currentAllocatedSize, sampled every 50 ms plus stage boundaries. Validation observers are included. These separate counters must not be summed. Kernel process-lifetime peaks are not reset per iteration; brief peaks may be missed by sampling.
modelVerificationScope: Model streams hashed before iterations; postflight rechecks source, executable, plan, references and asset declarations. Stream files must remain immutable during execution.

cases.prompt: a red fox in fresh snow
a watercolor painting of a red fox standing beside a frozen stream in a quiet snowy forest at sunrise, tall pine trees, soft golden light, delicate blue shadows, fine brushwork

timingScope: Provided conditioning is encoded, hash-validated and its encoder unloaded once per case, recorded separately outside iteration timing. Iterations reuse one denoiser/decoder session; conditioning measures only the provided-tensor handoff. Warmup step0 includes denoiser function loading; measured steps reuse retained functions. Steps include native calls, host copies and Euler updates. Decode includes loading when needed, copies and image validation. Stage timings exclude progress observers; total includes them. Preflight, one-time conditioning setup, final pixel hashing, report IO and unload are excluded. This profile does not measure fresh-prompt end-to-end latency.
